# Catalog

The Catalog lists the Products available in the Shop.

## Product

A Product has a name and a price. Each Product belongs to the Catalog.
The [Shop](./system.md#Shop) shall display every Product in the Catalog to the Customer.
docs/system.md:
# Shop

The Shop is an online store. A Customer browses the Shop and places an Order.

## Customer

A Customer is a person who holds a account. Each Customer must have a unique Email.

## Order

An Order is a purchase a Customer places. An Order contains one or more Products.
When a Customer submits an Order, the system shall send a confirmation Email.

A confirmation email should not be sent if Product is out of stock.
